# Review return: review-10aabbbb3d7e30c3

- `aa2b217615f3` is repaired at generator version `2.2.0`, SHA-256 `005b423a8f74efc1dc237121962de6fa9e445318bd91d0cacd72f952fb478a94`.
- Its defect was ordinary lessons that could omit a collision; every ordinary scene now contains a same-lane stacking witness.
- Its native family is exact-canonical `near_first` versus matched-input `far_first`, with 2–6 demonstrations and four queries.
- `a53fa114c4a9` is repaired at generator version `2.1.2`, SHA-256 `f6a5f232b0f3c9213764b550025a402055eec8487c8bfd68726e6d1c3b4ed65f`.
- Its defect was an advertised/drawn fifth legend pair despite a four-pair implementation cap; the supported axis is now consistently 2–4.
- Its native family is exact-canonical `explicit_mask` versus causal `merged_component`, also with 2–6 demonstrations and four queries.
- Focused task gates pass at 26/26 and 42/42; each family also ran 96 protected Racket audit evaluations and 32 preflight evaluations.
- Sequential projection checked 32 public views, 48 private-field invariance cases, and eight positive controls.
- A cross-family 512-seed-per-family fuzz tool and both 30x30 stress cases passed; the primary shortcut answer has protected-Racket evidence.
- Both builds are reviewer-ready. Owner native qualification, fresh acceptance, and any training admission remain pending and separate.

## `aa2b217615f3`

### Defect and repair

The previous ordinary sampler could produce examples where no two objects shared a movement lane, leaving “move every object independently to the edge” observationally adequate. The repair reserves two distinct-colored one-cell objects in one lane with an empty cell between them. `self_check` now rejects ordinary scenes without a collision-based stacking witness. The canonical rule bytes and rule hash `5b3e7ca4f11c` were not changed.

### Native family

The task-local adapter exposes only `stack_order`:

- `near_first`: exact canonical program, SHA-256 `1c4013808f534d37770a2398c9864d7b523a2706c04cbbcd98f563f763b1736d`.
- `far_first`: same inputs and rigid-object collision semantics, but commits farthest objects first.

The first two demonstrations distinguish the settings across the bounded audit. The causal witness executes the farthest object first, records its newly occupied cells, and shows that later objects stop differently when the order is changed. Evidence: `checks/

scope: Accepted generator repair; finite reviewer evidence, no new maintainer execution

sequential_dependency.intermediate: The fully recolored body together with its monochromatic 4-connected components and their occupied columns.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Apply the legend mapping to every body cell, merging alternating source colors that share a target into one monochromatic region.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Select the largest component in that recolored body, retain only color-1 mask columns intersecting it, and crop the recolored body to those columns.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: B computes component connectivity and the winning columns from A’s recolored body. Skipping A leaves a different solid decoy as the largest component, so B selects different columns and changes the final crop.
